purpose: Six additive whole-game art direction concepts, not actual runtime or real3D models

prompts.title: Đất biết kể
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one exceptionally art-directed, wide landscape 16:9 WHOLE-GAME VISUAL DEVELOPMENT BOARD for HỒNG BÀNG / MẠCH LẠC, an offline living-world narrative RPG inspired by ancient Vietnamese communities. This is a raster concept simulating the game appearance, not a screenshot of an implemented game or a real 3D scene. The world is about ordinary lives, work, kinship and consequential choices. Fictional early river settlement, timber/bamboo/thatch, handwoven clothes, useful tools; no modern objects, European castles, Chinese imperial roofs, fantasy armor or heroic weapons. Mature diverse Southeast Asian adults with believable individual faces, never a default cast of glamorous teenagers. No magical VFX, neon grading, teal-orange cinematic wash, rainbow AI colors, generic gold fantasy UI or ornamental clutter.
COMPOSITION: A confident editorial game-art board, not a moodboard collage. Approximately upper 65% is a legible in-game camera scene with a small understated contextual dialogue interface integrated at one edge, with ample unobstructed environment. Lower 35% has an orderly visual system strip: TWO DIFFERENT fully visible standing cast designs (distinct age, build and face, not merely front/back views of one person), THREE matching expressive close-up portraits, SIX distinct readable useful inventory icons, and two compact distinct journal and inventory UI samples. Avoid tiny panels and excessive labels. Every scene, character, icon, portrait and UI must convincingly belong to the specified visual language; do not paste a generic UI onto beautiful concept scenery. Keep readable silhouettes and walkable space; no need for a minimap, numerical stats or fabricated lore. Character samples illustrate received random lives, not a character creator. Text use only these short labels when needed, legibly: “ĐỐI THOẠI”, “TÚI ĐỒ”, “NHẬT KÝ”, “Hỏi chuyện”, “Giúp một tay”, “Rời đi”. Journal may use ruled lines and simple symbols instead of invented long text. No English descriptions, marketing slogans, reference logos or watermarks. The art direction is the main deliverable; choose strong shapes and disciplined values over indiscriminate detail. Do not put a big title over the board.

STYLE: tangible stop-motion clay and textile miniature art, sophisticated handmade adult folk drama. Not photorealistic humans or glossy plastic toys. Sculpted subtly asymmetrical faces, visible thumb marks, matte pigmented clay planes, real-looking woven miniature cloth and fiber. Full-body figures with adult proportions and expressive worn hands, strong noses/cheekbones, subtle wrinkles. Objects modeled as simple handcrafted volumes. Side three-quarter low oblique orthographic game camera, all key scene objects in focus, NO fake tilt-shift blur. Scene: a communal pottery kiln yard under a giant tree, damp earth after rain, warm brick kiln at left, drying earthen vessels on timber shelves, a working woman about55 carrying a shallow clay bowl, a tall thin man about30 managing a damaged drying rack. Social task not combat. Late overcast daylight; restrained iron-red clay, charcoal-brown, flax-cream, muted sage. Visible shadows/contact make volumes readable. Cast strip shows that broad older woman and lanky younger man separately; portraits same sculpted materials/eyes. UI uses shallow matte clay tabs and stitched linen fields with very crisp charcoal text, modest rounded edges, icons are little tactile hand-crafted objects (bowl, twine, clay lump, wood paddle, basket, cloth). The game should feel like entering an artisanal animated film with serious human stories, not a children's toy village.

STYLE: high-end clear-line European graphic-novel language reinterpreted through an ancient Vietnamese everyday world. Consistent fine near-black contours, flat opaque local colors, large blank paper areas, precisely drawn architecture and ordinary faces, very sparse solid shadow shapes; absolutely no painterly texture, gradient shading, 3D rendering, screentone, pixel art or anime faces. Visual clarity at small game scale. Scene: elevated three-quarter street view through a riverside weaving/dyeing courtyard, long indigo cloth hanging overhead to frame a cream-colored walking lane, two modest thatch houses and distant pale river. An elderly wiry dyer woman with grey shortbun and a broad middle-aged boat porter with a wrapped shoulder have a conversation about wet cloth; distinct full-body designs and expressive faces in strip. Quiet daylight. Palette principally offwhite, inkblack, restrained indigo, pale straw, one muted coral accessory; colors clean and deliberately few. Graphic dialogue uses clean rectangular offwhite comic boxes and a small black triangular speaker pointer; no manga speech explosion. Journal uses thin ruled ledger, inventory fine-line square cells and six flat outlined icons (fabric roll, shuttle, rope, bowl, carrying pole, reed basket). UI typography black on offwhite, a narrow indigo selected bar. Scene should be exceptionally composed like a playable adult graphic novel, light and humane, not noisy illustration.

STYLE: an audacious playable mineral-pigment fresco. Monumental flat angular silhouettes, dry matte red-earth and limestone pigment, worn uneven plaster, shallow frontal stage-like spatial tiers. NOT realistic painting, not ordinary ink wash, not paper cutout, not ceramic or bronze relief. Ancient human warmth through strong profile faces and gestures, not decorative generic tribal pattern. Camera wide side-oblique, village hillside terrace steps and a narrow irrigation channel forming clean diagonals. Main social scene: stocky woman stoneworker age40 resting a hand on a cracked channel stone while elderly farmer man with bent shoulders carries a reed measuring rod; distant rice-field terraces rendered as broad bands. No epic war/religious iconography. Palette red hematite, warm chalkwhite, coalblack and small dusty verdigris, at least 40% quiet negative area. Character body planes simplified with confident graphic geometry but anatomically adult; portraits full of personality through brow, nose and mouth shape. Two distinct fullbody characters and three fresco portraits below. UI uses simple pigment rectangles and chalk lines like pragmatic wall annotations, carefully aligned modern readable text without modern devices; inventory six powerful silhouettes of hoe, reed measure, seed pouch, stone wedge, water jar, cord. Journal is a restrained diagram of channel and task markers. Full scene, icons and UI are all painted in same dry mineral style; do not turn it into a museum photograph or ornate frame.

STYLE: a lost premium late-1990s pre-rendered isometric narrative CRPG, artful low-resolution game image with hand-painted baked lighting, compressed dithered shadow ramps, richly authored fixed-camera background, small volumetric characters and large bespoke painted dialogue portraits. NOT modern pixel tiles, voxel, smooth current-gen 3D, glossy mobile game, or generic medieval fantasy. Deliberate controlled coarse texture and atmospheric stage depth; no illegible oversharpening. Scene: rain at a river ferry toll shelter at dusk, fixed high-isometric camera, steep thatch eaves frame foreground, wet muddy open path, reed fence, moored ferry partly in view. A plump older ferryman woman with one greying braid and a lean middle-aged traveler wearing a patched reed cape are under a shelter comparing a broken ferry pole. Mature ordinary people, no armed heroes. Restrained deep walnut, slateblue, dirty ivory, tiny dim amber lamp accents; no neon split toning. Two distinct full-body character samples below, three handpainted expressive portraits with period digital brushwork. UI is highly functional compact charcoal/slate rectangular panels, simple thin grey borders, ivory serif text and modest selected line; no ornamental filigree. Inventory icons are six individually lit prerender-style useful objects (pole section, rope coil, reed cape, ceramic flask, basket, cloth pouch). Journal simple offwhite text lines on dark background. Convey cozy melancholy and dense lived-in world through authored light and scale, not through detail overload. Keep whole board crisp at its chosen visual resolution; not a photo of a CRT screen.

STYLE: bold black charcoal and silver drypoint night graphics on cold grey paper, almost monochrome with exactly one tiny muted cinnabar-red accent for selection. Not Japanese sumi-e/brushwash, not woodcut, not noir film photograph, not bronze. Tactile dry rubbed charcoal masses, fine scratched white edges and stippled silver moonlight; deliberately sharp silhouette hierarchy with large areas of empty darkness. Camera ground-level oblique 2.5D layered village scene, foreground reeds frame a public well and a raised community house at night. No horror monsters, no magic or combat; a short stout midwife about60 with white hair and a young adult apprentice man about28 with broad cheeks meet by a small oil lamp to carry clean water to a neighbor. Their readable faces and hands emerge from dark clothes, calm practical tenderness. Restrained moonlit greys, paperwhite, nearblack, a SINGLE tiny dull red cloth knot, no other color. Distinguish walkable ground with pale drypaper rather than pureblack noise. Character samples same drydrawing medium, two clearly distinct fullbody silhouettes and three portraits with real age. UI black quiet panels with thin chalkwhite rules and generous spacing, selected action a tiny dullred square; text highcontrast readable. Six scratch-drawn white-on-dark inventoryicons: ceramic waterjar, folded cloth, herbs, small lamp, ladle, basket. Journal faint chalkline relation/path diagram, inventory square cells. Must feel like a complete atmospheric social RPG visual language, not merely a beautiful landscape sketch. No gratuitous death symbolism.

STYLE: sophisticated lineless flat-color 2D animation for adult human stories, radical economy of shape, asymmetrical character design, exaggerated but credible adult proportions, strong readable block silhouettes, no contour outlines except sparse facial details, no airbrush, no texture overlay, no anime sparkle or Disney princess faces. Like a carefully art-directed contemporary animated feature; culturally grounded workclothes and tools, no imported fantasy costume. Landscape broad wide-angle near-horizontal 2.5D game view along a windy river levee and communal rice-drying ground. Wind rhythm expressed through 3 clear sweeping fabric/reed shapes, NOT motionblur. A heavyset middle-aged grain keeper woman with a square jaw and a long thin older carpenter man with a shaved/receding crown hold down the edge of a drying mat while other villagers work farther away. Two genuinely different fullbody cast plus three expressive flatshape portraits in strip. High bright cloud-white daylight; disciplined warm riceyellow, deep purplebrown, muted cool blue, generous white air; no green-teal-orange gradient. Foliage reduced to large cut-shape groups, uncluttered central readable action, distance by shape/value only. UI uses generous simple white/ink panels, broad rounded geometry that echoes characters, direct large legible text, selected action solid deep purple. Inventory six clean flatshape icons (rice scoop, straw mat roll, wood mallet, reed hat, basket, grain pouch). Journal uses big simple route marks and two clear cards. Give each icon a memorable silhouette. Every element from world to UI must share the same extreme shape simplification. Not a mobile farminggame dashboard, no cute chibi cast.
